text:
sam: Quick FYI — Support reported a 404 from a customer hitting our 'KV pro tips' anchor from an old blog link. Found a stale absolute link in /docs/guides/kv-cache-guide.md pointing to /guides/kv#pro-tips which returns 404.

leigh: Do you have the exact line? I can patch if it's just one spot.

sam: Yep: docs/guides/kv-cache-guide.md line ~120. Snippet: 
```
See also: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/kv#pro-tips
```

docs-bot: :mag: link-scan: Detected unreachable anchor /guides/kv#pro-tips referenced in docs/guides/kv-cache-guide.md (severity: medium).

rachel: Ugh. That anchor used to live in the community guide which we merged into kv-cache-guide last quarter and the header text changed. Easiest fix is to point to #best-practices within the merged doc.

harry: I can open a quick PR. Two options: 1) update the href to the new anchor, 2) add a frontmatter alias so the old absolute shortlink keeps resolving. If it's customer-visible I prefer adding an alias for backwards compat.

leigh: Agree on alias for the shortlink. Our frontmatter key is `redirect_from` across docs. Example: 
```yaml
---
redirect_from:
  - /guides/kv
---
```
That will help inbound links. Also, add a tiny addition to docs/link-check CI to assert the alias resolves (so future header renames don't silently break).

sam: Can you also grep for similar absolute links in the repo? I think the old blog still references a few.

harry: On it. quick grep: 
```bash
$ git grep -n "guides/kv#" -- docs | sed -n '1,50p'
docs/guides/kv-cache-guide.md:120: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/kv#pro-tips
docs/blog/2025-02-kv-best-practices.md:45: /guides/kv#pro-tips
```

rachel: Ok, plan: harry will open a branch to update the two links in docs and blog, add redirect frontmatter to docs/guides/kv-cache-guide.md, and include a minimal test in docs/link-check that fetches /guides/kv and ensures 200. I'll be reviewer for the docs changes.

harry: Drafting PR now, will push in ~15m. Using branch `fix/kv-alias-redirects-1859`.

docs-bot: PR created by harry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 — title: "fix(docs): restore old /guides/kv shortlink + anchor fixes"

leigh: Quick request for the PR: include a brief changelog entry in the PR template indicating customer-facing shortlink changed so Release Notes can judge if an announcement is needed.

harry: Added changelog section to the PR body. Also added a test in docs/link-check/tests/test_aliases.py: 
```python
def test_guides_kv_alias(client):
    resp = client.get('/guides/kv')
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert b'KV cache' in resp.data
```

sam: Nice. Ping me when it's merge-ready; I'll run the local site build to sanity-check anchors.

docs-bot: CI status: link-check passed, unit tests passed, preview build succeeded.

harry: @rachel ready for review — PR 5120.

rachel: Reviewing now. Two tiny nits: 1) normalize the redirect list order, 2) add a single-line comment in the test explaining why it's needed. Both are non-blocking.

harry: PTAL, pushed tiny fixes.

infra-bot: auto-deploy: preview available at https://deploy-preview-5120.docs.redwood.ai/ — expires in 7 days.

rachel: LGTM, approving.

docs-bot: PR #5120 merged by rachel (1860000185) — changes: updated two links, added redirect frontmatter to guides/kv-cache-guide.md, added link-check test.

sam: Thank you! Created a short note for Release Notes: "Docs: restored legacy /guides/kv shortlink to avoid broken blog links."

leigh: Closing loop — support confirmed the customer link now resolves. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: weekly-monitor: all anchor alerts for guides/kv-cache-guide.md cleared.

harry: Marking myself as owner for a follow-up sweep of the blog links next week. If anyone sees other broken KV anchors, drop them here and I'll batch them into the sweep.

sam: Will do. Thanks everyone.
